Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct and sudden drop in the value of E (mm) around an x-axis coordinate of 510. This step-change represents a clear anomaly compared to the gradual trend observed elsewhere in the data.

The anomaly can be characterized as the sharp transition itself. Looking closely at the graph:
- The drop begins just after x = 500, roughly around x = 510.
- The new lower level stabilizes almost immediately after the drop, by roughly x = 520.

Therefore, the range containing this anomalous event is approximately [510, 520].

[[510, 520]]
